سَبَّآءٌ A vintner, or seller of wine. (S, M, K.) ―
-b2- [It is said in a marginal note in my MS. copy of the K that it signifies also A seller of graveclothes: but this is evidently a mistake, app. occasioned by a mistranscription, for سَيَّآء, with ى.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
